title: Big Monster Gomera Murder Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Detective Boys, Professor Agasa) omitted by convention. No event nodes: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved, sharing an order integer. Two red-herring signals are captured on non-culprit suspects: Adachi is briefly implicated by the paint used for the footprint trick before his short absence clears him, and Mikami is treated as a live suspect on an unverifiable solo alibi plus nervous sweating, with no stated motive ever surfacing against him. case_type: murder.

attrs.announced: declared this Gomera film the franchise's last, publicly citing high costs and 'childish' monster movies as outdated

attrs.cleared_by: snuck out of the screening room for only 4-5 minutes, not enough time to don the suit, kill Kamei, and return

attrs.recognized_the_killer: recognized Matsui's running gait when she glimpsed the Gomera suit fleeing, from having been his acting partner for ten years, but initially lied to protect him

attrs.fate: removed near the roof stairwell, carried down the opposite stairs, and burned out a window to destroy sweat traces that would prove who had been running in it

objects.name: Can of paint left on the set

attrs.use: pre-placed during morning rehearsal so the killer could step in it and leave a trail of footprints on the stairs in advance, faking an escape route
attrs.initial_suspicion: Adachi was accused of planting it deliberately before he explained he'd simply forgotten it there after rehearsal

objects.name: Matsui's sweat-soaked shirt (changed and hidden in his bag)

attrs.significance: the shirt he was wearing when questioned had no sweat stains and no trace of juice Ayumi had spilled on him earlier, proving he had changed shirts after fleeing the murder scene in the costume

clues.desc: There is a Gomera tail-drag mark in the hallway but none on the stairs leading to the roof, even though the same 'Gomera' supposedly went that way -- proves only the legs of the costume were carried up (to plant footprints) while the culprit had already shed the suit and gone down the opposite stairwell.

Ayumi had spilled juice on Matsui's shirt earlier, but the shirt he is wearing when questioned afterward is unstained and unsweated despite his claim of having been immobilized in the storeroom the whole time -- proves he changed shirts after running in the costume.

Adachi's unaccounted absence from the screening room lasted only 4-5 minutes, not enough time to don the suit, commit the murder, and return -- rules him out despite the paint trail pointing toward him at first.

Mikami's alibi (alone on the first floor doing continuity checks) is unverifiable, and he visibly sweats under questioning -- both read as suspicious, but no motive against Kamei is ever found for him, and the case is ultimately built entirely on Matsui instead.
